title: GitHub Copilot CLI stream-json event
description: One event object from GitHub Copilot CLI `-p --output-format json` (JSONL: one object per line). Grammar derived from SPIKE-1 recorded transcript (docs/spikes/spike1-provider-contract.md §5.3) and §4.2. TD-1/TD-5 contract-parity fixture (test-plan §1). Copilot events are a parent-linked tree: non-`result` events carry a `data` object plus `id`/`timestamp`/`parentId`/`ephemeral`; the terminal `result` event is flat (fields at top level). Drift-tolerant: unknown `type` values validate, known ones are checked. Additional properties permitted.

type.description: Dotted event discriminator, e.g. session.mcp_servers_loaded, assistant.message, result.

allOf.$comment: Every non-result event carries a data object (§5.3).
Terminal result event is flat (§5.3 last line).
User message (§5.3): records what Cowrite sent.
